Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a specialized protein-RNA cross-linking assay (CLIR-MS/MS). While the instrument is an LTQ Orbitrap Elite (typically DDA), the acquisition mode is not explicitly stated as DDA or DIA in the text. The 'labeling' refers to the RNA being isotope-labeled, not the protein. The search parameters are highly specific for RNA adducts and neutral losses.

scope: to study the structure of the full-length PTBP1 in complex with an RNA derived from the IRES of EMCV (EMCV-IRES-DtoF, 84 nts)
cross-linking of segmentally isotope-labeled RNA with tandem mass spectrometry (CLIR-MS/MS), to study the structure of the full-length PTBP1 in complex with an RNA derived from the IRES of EMCV

Complex formation and purification were performed essentially as described before. In brief, EMCV-IRES-DtoF was diluted in all cases to approximately 4 µM in 5 mL low salt buffer (10 mM NaPO4, 20 mM NaCl, pH 6.5). Concentrated doubly-labeled PTBP1 was mixed with the RNA in a molar ratio of 1:1.2 and the complex was then purified by size-exclusion chromatography using a Superdex 75 column (Cytiva).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis (CLIR-MS/MS) was performed on a purified in vitro reconstituted complex of PTBP1 protein and EMCV-IRES RNA. While the protein is naturally nuclear, the material analyzed by MS was a purified complex, not a cellular fraction.
